name: The Queen's Gambit
description: In a 1950s orphanage, a young girl reveals an astonishing talent for chess and begins an unlikely journey to stardom while grappling with addiction.

videos.title: Openings
videos.overview: Sent to an orphanage at age 9, Beth develops an uncanny knack for chess — and a growing dependence on the green tranquilizers given to the children.

videos.title: Exchanges
videos.overview: Suddenly plunged into a confusing new life in suburbia, teenage Beth studies her high school classmates and hatches a plan to enter a chess tournament.

videos.title: Doubled Pawns
videos.overview: The trip to Cincinnati launches Beth and her mother into a whirlwind of travel and press coverage. Beth sets her sights on the U.S. Open in Las Vegas.

videos.title: Middle Game
videos.overview: Russian class opens the door to a new social scene. In Mexico City, Beth meets the intimidating Borgov, while her mother cozies up to a pen pal.

videos.title: Fork
videos.overview: Back home in Kentucky, a shaken Beth reconnects with a former opponent who offers to help sharpen her game ahead of the U.S. Championship.

videos.title: Adjournment
videos.overview: After training with Benny in New York, Beth heads to Paris for her rematch with Borgov. But a wild night sends her into a self-destructive spiral.

videos.title: End Game
videos.overview: A visit from an old friend forces Beth to reckon with her past and rethink her priorities — just in time for the biggest match of her life.

awards: Won 11 Primetime Emmys. 55 wins & 44 nominations total
